title: From in-house PM to consulting PM: What I didn't expect
partialText: Moving from in-house Product Management to consulting changed how I create impact. Without the same access and authority, I had to rely more on context, influence, and helping clients make decisions.

title: Client success starts before kickoff
partialText: Client success starts before kickoff, in how well we understand the problem, carry context forward, and set the right team up to deliver.
